decision: Accept the exact component and target-object resource gate. Prepare its production endpoint integration offline in this same project, request a cumulative $4 ceiling for one later warm-H200 endpoint comparison, and prohibit claim or lifecycle mutation until that reservation is durable and a later director binds execution.

exact_scope.intervention: QKV Q/K normalization plus RoPE with direct E5M2 NHD KV-cache commit
exact_scope.consumer: MHATokenToKVPool followed by the production local/global attention consumer

must_prove: The adapter reaches the exact pinned production producer and first cache-consuming attention boundary; a standalone fixture or source token check is insufficient.
The control is byte-identical to the qualified runtime stack except for the candidate adapter, and the matched pair uses the same exact c32 workload and cache/token accounting.
The candidate path emits explicit local/global invocation proof and preserves QKV numerical tolerance plus exact E5M2 cache-byte semantics before timing.
The owner has a real retained repair dispatcher, separate recoverable and terminal dispositions, one endpoint submission per arm, immutable per-arm roots, and a generation-fenced release path.
Every mutable source, adapter, runner, owner, workload, and command byte is content-addressed in ENDPOINT_INTEGRATION_PACKET_R1.json.

lifecycle.extension_gate: A later director may replace the watchdog only after the cumulative $4 project reservation is durable and endpoint preparation remains likely to finish within the retained-state break-even window. If preparation fails or is no longer competitive before extension, drain and clean instead.

supersession.reason: The exact target-object recovery became durable concurrently before the offline-adoption binding was scheduled. Accept the new artifact and do not redispatch redundant CUBIN extraction.

must: Use $researcher with execution profile, $kernel-research, and $experiment-run for offline preparation only.
Prepare the smallest exact pinned-runtime endpoint adapter and a lifecycle-pure matched-pair owner without claiming or running.
Publish ENDPOINT_INTEGRATION_PACKET_R1.json only after every bound byte is final and hash-validated.
Keep the project claim-disabled until a later director observes the cumulative $4 reservation and issues a fresh execution binding.
must_not: Do not replay the consumed component or its timings.
Do not claim or SSH to the H200, invoke CUDA, load the checkpoint, start a server, or submit an endpoint request.
Do not call provider lifecycle or extend the watchdog under the current $1 durable reservation.
Do not create a new repair, audit, readiness, endpoint-successor, or integration project for this same mechanism.
